I wonder if the person you’ve written off is carrying something you need for your destiny? If you only see them through the lens of your past, you can miss what God has placed in them for your future. This is not one-size-fits-all. Some people, you should keep away. They’re unhealthy. But you need…

Thank God that He doesn’t deny us access forever because we failed, were dishonest, manipulated, hurt others. We’re not proud of it, but by His grace, we’ve changed. We’re not the same person who we were. Do the same for others. Give people who have done you wrong room to change.

It’s easy to keep people in a box and think, “They hurt me. They did me wrong. They’re jealous, self-centered.” We lock them into the version of who they were. But while we kept them out, what we couldn’t see was that God was working on them. That version wasn’t the final version. It was a season.

It’s important to forgive people. You’re not excusing their behavior. You’re not saying what they did was okay. You’re forgiving them so that the hurt doesn’t turn into bitterness and contaminate your life. If you hold on to the wrongs, then you’re allowing that person to continue to hurt you.

God is going to do some new things in your life. Not what you’ve seen in the past. It’s going to be unusual where you’re not only astounded, but people around you are going to be astounded. Listen to the Joel Osteen Daily Podcast everywhere you listen to podcasts!
